name: onboarding
title_zh: 自助部署 Open-Inspect 实例的全程向导
tagline_zh: 从仓库克隆到 Terraform 部署再到验证，全程有人带你走。不用翻文档猜步骤，每步都留好交接点。
tagline_en: From repo clone to Terraform deploy to verification, guided end-to-end. No doc-hunting, no guesswork—each step.
desc_en: Deploy your own Open-Inspect instance. Use when the user wants to set up, deploy, or onboard to Open-Inspect. Guides through repository setup, credential collection, Terraform deployment, and verification with user handoffs.
why_zh: 它把部署拆成可确认的节点，每步都要求你确认再继续，而不是一把梭跑完。适合怕出错、想边做边懂的人。
why_en: It breaks deployment into confirmable checkpoints, pausing for your input at each handoff—so you learn as you go instead of.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Open-Inspect 官方仓库的部署路径；不处理自建 fork、离线环境或已有实例的迁移。
limit_en: Only covers the official Open-Inspect repo path; no forks, offline setups, or migrating existing instances. You manage Terraform state yourself—no.
